observed_parent_evidence.credit_boundary: No J-Space model, full-HCU, whole-EntityOS, training or canonical-semantics credit is implied.

new_counterhypothesis.statement: AFFIRMATIVE, NEGATIVE and NEUTRAL need not lie on one latent line. Collapsing NEGATIVE and NEUTRAL into one averaged opposite pole can produce a reproducible AFFIRMATIVE steering effect while hiding a second independent semantic degree of freedom.
new_counterhypothesis.why_material: Three distinguishable semantic states generically require up to two independent centered contrasts. A single AFFIRMATIVE-versus-rest vector can establish one causal contrast without establishing that the reusable J-Space control geometry is one-dimensional.
new_counterhypothesis.falsifier: Across lexically disjoint label-free families, the centered class-centroid geometry is rank-1 within a preregistered permutation/noise tolerance and class-specific intervention effects are explained by one signed axis on fresh holdout.

primary_hypothesis.statement: The three semantic decision states occupy a stable low-dimensional class-selective subspace at the retained nonterminal site, with one or two causal dimensions that generalize across lexical families.
primary_hypothesis.prediction: Centered class centroids form a reproducible subspace whose singular spectrum exceeds a class-permutation null, and native interventions derived from class-centroid directions produce a class-selective treatment matrix rather than uniform requested-code uplift.

proposed_discriminator.name: LABEL_FREE_THREE_STATE_SEMANTIC_SIMPLEX_NATIVE_CVEC
phase_0_freeze: Keep the exact evidenced Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 GGUF and pinned llama.cpp build/runtime identity.
Keep layer 20 as the preregistered first site unless a separate calibration-only successor law explicitly changes it.
Do not select dimensionality, gain, thresholds or metric after opening fresh holdout.
phase_1_label_free_family_centroids: Use at least three lexically disjoint scenario families per semantic class with class identity stored in experiment metadata, not model-facing pole labels.
Compute one activation centroid per class and family at the same named nonterminal site.
Preserve exact prompt, activation, checkpoint, tokenizer, layer and runtime identities.

phase_2_rank_test.centered_vectors: For global class means mu_A, mu_N, mu_U, define c=(mu_A+mu_N+mu_U)/3 and class displacements s_i=mu_i-c. These sum to zero and span at most two dimensions.
phase_2_rank_test.rank_statistic: Compare singular values sigma1 and sigma2 of family-centered class contrasts against a deterministic class-assignment permutation null and leave-one-family-out stability.
phase_2_rank_test.decision: If sigma2 is not distinguishable from null, retain a one-dimensional model. If sigma2 is reproducibly above null, require a two-dimensional semantic subspace for promotion claims.

phase_3_class_specific_native_interventi.directions: Use equal-norm class-centroid displacements s_A, s_N, s_U, or their exactly equivalent coordinates in the frozen orthonormal basis; no output-label-derived direction is allowed.
phase_3_class_specific_native_interventi.runtime: Serialize each selected direction through the same pinned native llama.cpp cvec path with exact bytes and successful llama_set_adapter_cvec receipt before decode.

phase_4_independent_evaluation_counterba.layout: Cross three requested semantic targets with independently rotated A/B/C output-code mappings inside each fresh lexical family.
phase_4_independent_evaluation_counterba.freshness: Evaluation families are disjoint from basis and calibration families and remain unopened until all calibration/rank decisions are frozen.
phase_4_independent_evaluation_counterba.metric: For each case use mapped-target logit margin versus the mean of the other two code logits.

phase_5_primary_causal_matrix.definition: D[i,j] = mean(margin under class-direction intervention i for requested class j - matched baseline margin for class j).
phase_5_primary_causal_matrix.generic_compliance_signature: Rows of D show broadly positive uplift across requested classes with weak diagonal selectivity.
phase_5_primary_causal_matrix.class_specific_signature: For every intervention i, D[i,i] exceeds the mean off-diagonal effect by a preregistered calibration-derived margin, and nuisance controls do not reproduce this diagonal advantage.
phase_5_primary_causal_matrix.rank_check: After removing row/column nuisance means, compare the effective rank of D with the representation-space rank decision; disagreement is negative evidence against a simple shared semantic control geometry.

phase_6_sign_and_off_target_checks: SIGN_FLIP must change the preregistered class-selectivity pattern rather than merely lower all logits.
Orthogonal/permuted same-norm controls must not reproduce class-selective diagonal structure.
Label-only nuisance control must not reproduce the semantic matrix.
Run structurally matched nonsemantic codebook tasks to bound generic code-emission/instruction-following drift.

scientific_advantage_over_single_axis: Directly tests whether NEGATIVE and NEUTRAL are genuinely one opposite pole or separable latent states.
Rejects generic compliance using a full intervention-by-target matrix instead of one pooled affirmative contrast.
Provides an empirical criterion for whether J-Space control should remain a single vector or graduate to a small subspace without assuming dimensionality in advance.
Aligns representation geometry with causal behavior: a representation-only second dimension receives no causal credit unless its intervention effect survives fresh holdout and nuisance controls.

external_primary_inputs.source: Turner et al., Steering Language Models With Activation Engineering
external_primary_inputs.use: Supports direct residual-stream activation intervention as a causal steering mechanism.

external_primary_inputs.source: Panickssery et al., Steering Llama 2 via Contrastive Activation Addition
external_primary_inputs.use: Supports contrastive activation directions and signed inference-time intervention.

external_primary_inputs.source: Stolfo et al., Improving Instruction-Following in Language Models through Activation Steering
external_primary_inputs.use: Demonstrates that activation steering can enhance generic instruction adherence, keeping compliance as a live counterhypothesis.

external_primary_inputs.source: Braun et al., Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models
external_primary_inputs.use: Supports cross-family direction-coherence and per-example sign/reliability checks rather than mean-only conclusions.

external_primary_inputs.source: Torop et al., Inverted Detection and Control in Steering Vectors
external_primary_inputs.use: Supports explicit separation of representation discrimination from causal control and sign validation.
Provides precedent for combining multiple representation directions with an orthonormalized subspace rather than blindly summing correlated directions.

hcu_jspace_implication_if_verified.current_abi: Do not change canonical JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 from research alone.
hcu_jspace_implication_if_verified.possible_successor: If rank-2 causal evidence is verified, consider an additive successor packet carrying an orthonormal basis plus bounded coefficient vector and exact basis/runtime receipts, while keeping canonical truth/effect authority unchanged.
hcu_jspace_implication_if_verified.promotion_boundary: Subspace geometry is a candidate/measurement until exact native causal evidence passes; no model-generated geometry mints truth.

unusual_experiment.reason: No canonical shared immutable macrocycle/request identity plus create-only unusual-experiment lease was available for a new native intervention in this standalone research run.

research_delta: Adds a dimensionality falsifier above the current compliance and lexical-confound gates: test whether the three semantic decision states are genuinely one-dimensional or require a two-dimensional causal subspace, using label-free cross-family centroids, a permutation-null rank decision and a class-intervention-by-target matrix.
next_exact_action: Implement a deterministic source-only simplex/rank analysis capsule over label-free calibration activations first. It must decide ONE_DIMENSIONAL_SUPPORTED vs TWO_DIMENSIONAL_REQUIRED vs UNRESOLVED without opening fresh holdout. Only after that, and only with canonical unusual-experiment coordination, execute the corresponding native cvec class-selectivity matrix.
